clips.title: The story
paras: An Alliance warlock seeking to craft powerful vestments is directed by the Mage Quarter's covert practitioners to seek out Menara Voidrender across the Great Sea. Stationed high above the neutral port of Ratchet, Menara trains dark spellcasters across faction divides in the dangerous arts of binding and artifact creation.

Within the dark crypts beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind, warlock trainer Demisette Cloyce is known for her strict, unsparing standards. When an aspiring warlock reaches the threshold of weaving significant items of power, Demisette rarely believes they are truly ready. Nevertheless, higher authorities within the cabal mandate the student's advancement, dispatching them far from the safety of the capital to prove their mettle.

The destination is the arid hills overlooking the goblin port of Ratchet in the Barrens. There, Menara Voidrender maintains her laboratory in a stone tower. Isolated from the strict laws of Stormwind and the watchful eyes of Orgrimmar, Menara accepts apprentices regardless of race or political allegiance, knowing that the fiends and demonic entities warlocks contend with harbor equal malice toward every mortal soul.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Let us be clear about one thing, friend: I don't feel you are ready for such responsibilities. I don't think aiding in the creation of any item of power is something a novice should ever be involved in; especially one so untested.
But that's not my decision. The powers that be, or at least the ones that do wish to impart such gifts upon you get to decide that.
If you're interested in learning more, I suggest you seek out Menara Voidrender in Ratchet. She usually resides in the tower above the port town.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, Demisette sent you. Good. Then word does reach far enough to find future students. This pleases me.

It is typical of our kind, friend, to band together, regardless of race. It is especially important since those we deal with most do not discriminate in their malice if we fail to appease them or control them properly.
I feel you've learned a great many things, and if you are willing, I would help you create tools to compliment your skills.
